data.title: Pink Bow Birthday Invitation Template Set, Coquette Bow Birthday Invite, Editable PDF No Account, Thank You Card, Welcome Sign
data.description:
Pink bow birthday invitation set you type into right inside the PDF: no design app, no account, no login, just the free Adobe Acrobat Reader. One download gives you the invitation, a matching details card, thank-you cards and an 8x10 welcome sign, each in pink and in sage cabana stripes with a cream scalloped card, a pink coquette bow and green palm leaves. Made for a sweet 16, 21st, 30th or any girl's birthday. Type your details, print at home, and everything is ready the same day.

WHAT YOU GET (one PDF: 8 printable pages, 4 designs in 2 colors, plus a how-to page)
- 5x7 invitation in pink cabana stripe and in sage cabana stripe (2 per page)
- 5x7 matching details card in pink and in sage (sample headings: What to wear, Gifts, Parking; retype them to anything)
- 5x7 thank-you card in pink and in sage, with your own message and signature (2 per page)
- 8x10 welcome sign in pink and in sage with the guest of honor's name, age and date (frame it or prop it on the table)
- How-to page with wording ideas for the name line (name lines hold up to 26 letters on the invitation and 12 on the sign)
- 86 type-in lines: name, date, time, place, address, RSVP, the details card's headings and lines, the thank-you card's top line, message and signature, and both signs

HOW IT WORKS
1. Download the PDF from Etsy (You > Purchases > Download files) on a computer. Editing needs a computer; the file opens anywhere.
2. Open it in Adobe Acrobat Reader (free) and click the green text to type your own details.
3. Save, then print at 100% / Actual size on US Letter or A4 cardstock, at home or at a print shop.
4. Cut on the light corner marks. Each card is 5 x 7 inches and fits an A7 envelope; the sign is 8 x 10 inches.

GOOD TO KNOW
- This is a digital PDF download. No printed cards, signs or envelopes are shipped.
- The headlines, stripes, bow and leaves are part of the design. Fonts and colors cannot be changed.
- Each card on a page edits on its own, so you can make two versions on one sheet.
- Personal use only. Questions or a typo you can't fix? Message me and I'll help.

This design was created with AI assistance under the creative direction of the seller.
